summary: Practise emergency WASH risk assessment, water safety and response planning using Sphere and WHO guidance. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Public-health WASH emergency training helps foundation-level field and coordination staff assess water, sanitation and hygiene risks and prioritize response actions. Guided exercises develop skills in documenting hazards and water-quality results, tracing fecal contamination, choosing sanitation priorities, drafting feasible hygiene messages and recording indicators for follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course suits staff who assess, coordinate or deliver water, sanitation and hygiene actions during public-health emergencies. It is designed for foundation-level learners who need field-ready methods and clear response records.
modules: WHO Risk Assessment in Emergency Sites
WASH Cluster Coordination and Outbreak Signals
prerequisites: No prior emergency WASH experience is stated as a requirement. The course uses basic field observations and simple monitoring tables; programming is not required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
